basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old software enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. Currently working as a junior software developer at a tech startup. My main interests revolve around learning new programming languages and exploring various tech communities. In my free time, I enjoy hiking the trails around Austin and experimenting with homebrewed cider recipes. I'm single and typically online during the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been self-teaching various programming languages since high school. My current job has greatly expanded my knowledge in C# and Python, and I'm always eager to learn more through online courses and community discussions.
